BA25.input_model: DBO + arbitrary canonical foreign CNF represented by variable-localized factor graph G_star

gaps.statement: No theorem proves that one fixed exact polynomial reduction controller maps every CNF to a residual with tau=O(log n) or to a fixed audited polynomial tractable terminal class.
No adversarial family has yet been proved to force tau(REDUCE(F_n))=Omega(n^alpha) while evading every audited tractable terminal; this is H3.

BA25 consumes a supplied verified decomposition. Known single-exponential constant-factor treewidth algorithms can provide certified decompositions; if residual tau=O(log n), their 2^O(tau)n cost and constant-factor width remain polynomial. No heuristic min-fill value may be promoted to exact treewidth.

The terminal-class catalogue is incomplete. R38 is outside renamable-Horn, dual-Horn and beta-acyclic; q-Horn was explicitly not audited at R38. H2 cannot be evaluated until the fixed class set and exact recognizers are frozen.
Exact clause/variable reductions need not monotonically decrease incidence/factor treewidth merely because (C,L,V) decreases. Width before/after exact reductions must be measured independently.
BA25 arbitrary-CNF semantic embedding does not certify arbitrary foreign-CNF BA4 carrier transport. Source-return authority remains only where sealed parent routes apply.
Even a project-specific proof-carrying integration cannot substitute for the missing universal structural theorem. Literature novelty and decision completeness are independent questions.

H1.if_proved: Together with a certified constant-factor decomposition route and BA25, yields a polynomial composed decision/count/witness route for the exact frozen reducer, subject to all source/scope obligations.

H2.statement: REDUCE(F) in LOW_WIDTH UNION union_{i=1}^k C_i for a fixed finite set of audited polynomial tractable classes
H2.required_next: Freeze exact terminal catalogue and exact recognizers; include q-Horn audit before treating R38 as outside that catalogue.

H3.statement: EXISTS F_n: tau(REDUCE(F_n))=Omega(n^alpha) while residuals evade every audited tractable terminal
H3.role: Potential falsifier of H1/H2-style universal funnel strategies.

if_H1: certified 2^O(tau)n constant-factor treewidth approximation gives width O(log n)
composition_logic.important_nonclaim: The existence of the conditional composition does not establish SAT_IN_P.

primary_blocker.question: CAN CHEAP EXACT REDUCTION FORCE EVERY SAT RESIDUAL INTO LOW WIDTH OR A FIXED TRACTABLE TERMINAL CLASS?
primary_blocker.why_primary: R37 already separates polynomial termination from semantic decision; BA25 already supplies the bounded-width solver. The unresolved bridge is universal structure of the residuals produced by the reducer.
